name: retry-with-fallback
description: A cost-aware error-handling pattern: a primary Model call with a tight max_cost_usd, a Branch on whether the output is empty/errored, + a fallback to a more-capable (still down-routed) model on failure. Demonstrates the Branch + the two-path fallback — the receipt captures both attempts' costs so the retry overhead is visible, not hidden.
